# nacchoProfile

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/NACCHO-profile/nacchoProfile/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NACCHO-profile/nacchoProfile/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

A Shiny application that visualizes findings from NACCHO's National Profile
of Local Health Departments.

## ⚠️ Prerequisites

This repository references two **private** data repositories as Git submodules:

- `NACCHO-profile/nacchoProfile_data` — compiled `.rda` datasets
- `NACCHO-profile/nacchoProfile_dataraw` — raw data and derivation scripts

Without access to these private repos, `data/` and `data-raw/` will be empty
after cloning, and the app will fail to load its datasets.

### Access requirements

1. **Organization membership** — You must be a member of the `NACCHO-profile`
   GitHub organization, or have been granted read access to both private data
   repos. Contact the maintainer to request access.
2. **SSH key registered with GitHub** — Submodules use `git@github.com:` URLs.
   Verify with:

   ```sh
   ssh -T git@github.com
   ```

   Expected output: `Hi <username>! You've successfully authenticated...`

## Setup

### Clone with submodules

```sh
git clone --recurse-submodules git@github.com:NACCHO-profile/nacchoProfile.git
cd nacchoProfile
```

If you already cloned without `--recurse-submodules`, populate the submodules:

```sh
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

Or from the R console:

```r
system2("git", c("submodule", "update", "--init", "--recursive"))
```

### Restore R dependencies

```r
renv::restore()
```

### Run the app

```r
shiny::runApp()
```

Or install as a package and launch via the exported function:

```r
devtools::install()
nacchoProfile::run_app()
```

### Update the data

The `data/` submodule pins a specific commit of `nacchoProfile_data`. To pull
the latest datasets:

```sh
git submodule update --remote data
git add data
git commit -m "Update data submodule"
```

## How data is loaded

The `.rda` files in `data/` are **package datasets**, documented in
`R/document_data.R` (e.g. `master_data`, `meta`, `spec_data`). They are
lazy-loaded when the package is installed, so `master_data` is available
directly after `library(nacchoProfile)` without an explicit `data()` call.

The `data-raw/` submodule contains the derivation scripts used to produce
those `.rda` files. It is **excluded from the package build** (`.Rbuildignore`)
and is only needed when regenerating datasets.

## Deployment (shinyapps.io)

The app deploys to shinyapps.io under the `naccho` account. The deployment
record lives at `rsconnect/shinyapps.io/naccho/nacchoProfile.dcf`.

**Critical:** `rsconnect::deployApp()` bundles the *local working directory*.
Before deploying, confirm the submodules are populated:

```sh
git submodule status
# Both lines should start with a commit SHA, not '-'
```

If either starts with `-`, run:

```sh
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

Otherwise the deployed app will ship with empty `data/` and fail to load
its datasets at runtime.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `data/` is empty after clone | Cloned without `--recurse-submodules` | `git submodule update --init --recursive` |
| `Permission denied (publickey)` | SSH key not registered, or not authorized for the org | `ssh -T git@github.com`; confirm org membership |
| `Repository not found` | No read access to the private data repos | Request access from the maintainer |
| `object 'master_data' not found` after load | `data/` submodule empty at install time | Re-run `git submodule update --init --recursive`, reinstall |
| Deployed app loads but charts are empty | Submodules were empty at `deployApp()` time | Populate submodules, redeploy |
